topics.description: The FBI is investigating election fraud in Arizona and other states, with a focus on the 2020 presidential election. This trend is significant because it highlights the ongoing concerns about the integrity of the electoral process in the United States.

Medicaid providers in New York are under investigation for fraud, with allegations of improper billing and kickbacks. This trend is significant because it highlights the ongoing concerns about waste and abuse in the Medicaid program.
